parameters.name: GwDeviceName
parameters.description: The name of the gateway device.

parameters.name: GwProductKey
parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to which the gateway device belongs.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: TopoAddItem
parameters.description: The list of device topology relationships to add.

sub_parameters.name: ClientId
sub_parameters.description: The device-side ID. You can use the SN or MAC address of the device. This parameter is optional. If you specify this parameter, include it in the signature calculation.

sub_parameters.name: DeviceName
sub_parameters.description: The device name of the sub-device to be connected to the gateway.

sub_parameters.name: ProductKey
sub_parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to which the sub-device belongs.

sub_parameters.name: Sign
sub_parameters.description:
The signature for adding the topology relationship.
The value of Sign is calculated by using the signature method **SignMethod(deviceSecret,content)**.

In this formula, **content** is the result of sorting all sub-device parameters (excluding Sign and SignMethod) that are submitted to the server in alphabetical order and concatenating them without delimiters.

For example, if the device parameters are **ClientId=868575026974305, DeviceName=868575026974305, ProductKey=a1PB5fp1234, SignMethod=hmacmd5, and deviceSecret=1234**, the signature is calculated as `hmacmd5(1234, clientId868575026974305deviceName868575026974305productKeya1PB5fpX1234)`. The calculation result is `C1C1606D61884C5F16C9EA6622E5****`.
> In this example, **ClientId** is the client ID of the device, which you can customize.

sub_parameters.name: SignMethod
sub_parameters.description: The signature method. Valid values: **hmacSha1**, **hmacSha256**, **hmacMd5**, and **Sha256** (case-insensitive).

sub_parameters.name: Timestamp
sub_parameters.description: The UTC timestamp. This parameter is optional. If you specify this parameter, include it in the signature calculation.
